title: CTRL control / HMI board (two-sided, 4 layers)
note: W2 PCB-CTRL: control / HMI board, two-sided, 4 layers (A-PCB-07). Top: the six TL3145 at the contract switch points, MCP23017 U301-U303, PI4IOE5V9555 U306, the HMI resistors and TVS and the two ENC headers at the cut-outs. Bottom: the THT harness headers (hand-soldered from the top; pin field + 1.0 mm kept free on the top), the Raspberry Pi Pico U305 (its 23.1 x 53.9 mm courtyard does not fit the top between the switch columns and the cut-outs), the buzzer, the LED and the small SMD parts. Iteration 2: scripted LAB5 feed, blower return and fan copper, GND plane vias, fan cluster re-placed. CI/model output of pcb/board_gen.py; not a fabrication release; bench gates OPEN.

layers.source: mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json stackup (4 layers, JLC04161H-7628, build/15 "Шари") and pcb/generated/netclasses.json stackup
layers.types_why: In1.Cu (L2) carries a solid GND plane laid before routing and typed power, so the Specctra export marks it (type power) and Freerouting does not route on it; every SMD GND pad has its own scripted via to it. F.Cu, In2.Cu and B.Cu are routing layers; the power classes route on F.Cu/B.Cu only (router.class_layers), as pcb/check_boards.py requires (netclasses.json: no inner copper for PWR3A, 1.8 mm inner for PWR1A).

plan.F.Cu: L1: top parts, signals, scripted LAB5 feed J305 -> J314.2 (1.85 mm) and C342 branch, scripted 3V3_Q6A pieces (right pull-up column, MCP pins), scripted E3_PICO3V3 pieces (HMI2/HMI3 bus along cut-out 1 to R368/R395, the HMI pull-up row to C312 and U306, R361/R362), the frozen router copper of route run 43136394379 and its completion (route-frozen.json), GND pour after routing
plan.In1.Cu: L2: GND plane (pre-route zone, DSN plane) with 5 locked slow signal links of the frozen route completion (W2 CTRL-R; 70 mm in all): E3_PICO3V3 (0.2 mm, 35.6 mm up the right strip beside cut-out 1 between the vias P33-V-R368 and P33-V-R4B), E3_REC_EXT 14.9 mm, PG_BONI 11.2 mm, E3_MARK_EXT 4.3 mm and PG_LNB 3.8 mm (0.15 mm, under the Pico and the HMI rows); the plane flows around them
plan.In2.Cu: L3: signals, the scripted 18 mm LAB5 run to D301 below cut-out 1, the scripted 3V3_Q6A bus of the left pull-up column, the frozen router copper and its completion, GND pour after routing
plan.B.Cu: L4: bottom parts, signals, scripted E3_BLOWER_GND rail and E3_FAN5 (1.85 mm) and the E3_BLOWER_GND capacitor branches, scripted LAB5 islands, scripted E3_PICO3V3 pieces (R4B bus along cut-out 2, up the right strip and along the top edge to J312.4, branch to R362; Pico pin 36 escape via, R330/R327/C308), locked GND copper over the custom Pico GND pads, the frozen router copper and its completion, GND pour after routing
